pub assume_specification<T, E, F, O>[Result::<T, E>::or_else](
    result: Result<T, E>,
    op: O,
) -> (res: Result<T, F>)
where
    O: FnOnce(E) -> Result<T, F>,
    requires
        result is Err ==> op.requires((result->Err_0,)),
    ensures
        result is Ok ==> res == Result::<T, F>::Ok(result->Ok_0),
        result is Err ==> op.ensures((result->Err_0,), res),
;
